# Angela Jeune

Angela Jeune is a former States Member, first elected to the States of Jersey in 2008.

Angela Jeune has participated in 4 elections since 2002:

- [**2008 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/angela-jeune#e12)

  Elected as Deputy of St Brelade No 1 with 56.7% of the vote.
- [**2011 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/angela-jeune#e15)

  Not elected.

  - [2011 Vote.je Manifesto](https://web.archive.org/web/20111129104433/http://www.vote.je:80/candidates/deputies/st-brelade-district-1/Angela-Jeune)
  - [2011 Full Manifesto](https://web.archive.org/web/20110928133630/http://www.channel103.com:80/election/?page_id=84)
- [**2014 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/angela-jeune#e20)

  Not elected.

  - [2014 Vote.je Manifesto](https://web.archive.org/web/20230401130907/https://archive.vote.je/portfolio/jeune-angela/)
  - [2014 Vote.je Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6An_GRIK2bM)
- [**2022 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/angela-jeune#e48)

  Not elected.

  - [2022 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2022/angela-juene/)
  - [2022 Vote.je Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0q-TNIbJI-8)

## Election History

### 2008 Deputies Election

Election for the role of Deputy of [St Brelade No 1](https://flow.je/elections/st-brelade-no-1) (1 seat), 26th November 2008.

**Angela Jeune was elected as Deputy of St Brelade No 1 in 2008**.

|  | Name | Party | Votes |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | **Angela Jeune** |  | 370 | 56.7% |
| 2 | [Mark Sutton](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/mark-sutton) |  | 192 | 29.4% |
| 3 | [Alan Beadle](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/alan-beadle) |  | 86 | 13.2% |

652 votes (inc. 4 spoilt papers)

2,367 registered voters

= 27.5% turnout
